title: Optimize indexed join probe cache hit path
constraints: Preserve indexed join probe, residual predicate, LIMIT, and left join semantics
rationale: The indexed join probe loop used a HashMap contains/get pattern for cached probe keys. Splitting hit and miss paths lets repeated probe keys reuse the result of a single HashMap::get and keeps async fetch work limited to misses.
steps: Extract shared join probe candidate materialization into a synchronous helper
Use a single HashMap::get on cache hits
Fetch, filter, process, and then cache candidates on misses
Verify indexed join probe and left join behavior
expected_impact: Reduces hash table work for repeated indexed join probe keys and removes repeated joined-row construction code in the probe path.
